SheWolves Ride

San Diego, CA · Balboa Park · Social · Mixed

Women / trans / femmeLGBTQ+No-drop

SheWolves Ride is a social group ride in San Diego, CA. It rolls monthly, on a Thursday at 7:15 pm from Bea Evenson Fountain, Balboa Park. Pace: no-drop evening loop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:15 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: no-drop evening loop. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @sd_shewolves the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the SheWolves Ride group ride

A no-drop evening loop from the fountain in Balboa Park for women, trans, femme, queer, gender-nonconforming and other riders who don't always feel welcome on standard group rides. Sources disagree on whether it runs weekly or monthly, so check Instagram for the next date.
